name: Hybrid App Shell (Cordova + React SPA + in-APK source maps)
description: Cordova wrapper around a 94MB React SPA; only 5 app-native Java files; full TypeScript sources recoverable from shipped .map files.
behavior_summary: Hosts the entire parent dashboard; native layer is a thin bridge.

reusability_assessment.notes: Study the hybrid pattern; Family OS stays native but the JS logic is the IP source.

name: Deferred Deep-Link Bridge (QustodioPlugin)
description: Cordova plugin buffering ACTION_VIEW intents until the web app signals readiness, then injecting javascript:handleOpenURL(url); accepts qustodio* schemes and https://*.qustodio.com/parents-app.
behavior_summary: Solves cold-start deep links for hybrid apps.

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy verbatim for any WebView-based module; manifest scheme is qustodiofamily://.

name: Dual-Route Push Service (Braze/FCM)
description: QustodioPushNotificationService extends FCMService: tries BrazeFirebaseMessagingService.handleBrazeRemoteMessage first, falls back to FCM.
behavior_summary: Separates marketing push (Braze) from functional push (FCM) in one service.

reusability_assessment.notes: Elegant pattern for dual push providers.

name: Redux + Epics + Records State Architecture
description: Redux (redux-immutable) + redux-thunk + redux-observable epics + Immutable.js records with fromPayload/serialize contract per model; ~60 ducks, ~35 record domains.
behavior_summary: Single serialization contract per API model prevents client/server drift.

reusability_assessment.notes: Adopt the fromPayload/serialize record pattern in Family OS data layer.

name: Route Map (~60 routes)
description: react-router v3 hashHistory tree under /profiles/:profileId/: rules/*, routines, screen-time, activity-timeline, familyLocator, devices, upgrade.
behavior_summary: Full IA of a parental-control dashboard; profile-centric nesting.

reusability_assessment.notes: Reference IA for Family OS parent dashboard navigation.

name: QApi Client (95 endpoint groups)
description: Hand-rolled fetch client: endpoint() builder, request transformers, QApiCache TTL, 10s timeout, typed Endpoint groups for v1/v2 APIs.
behavior_summary: Uniform REST access with caching and param swapping.

reusability_assessment.notes: Model Family OS API client on endpoint-group + transformer pattern.

name: OAuth2 Session Subsystem
description: POST /v1/oauth2/access_token (form-urlencoded); silent refresh on 401 with single retry; refresh denial triggers logout callback.
behavior_summary: Standard OAuth2 with transparent recovery.

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy flow; store tokens in secure storage, not localStorage.

name: Per-Platform Client Credentials
description: client_id/secret selected per AuthorizationApplication from qinit.tenant.parents_app.platforms.{android,ios,web}.
behavior_summary: Multi-tenant OAuth client selection.

reusability_assessment.notes: Use build-time tenant config; never hardcode secrets in source.

name: localStorage Persistence Model
description: Typed key registry (accessToken, refreshToken, parentDeviceId, onboardingTokenData...) persisted via persistentStorage duck; plaintext.
behavior_summary: Simple key-value persistence; insecure for secrets.

reusability_assessment.notes: REJECT plaintext token storage; migrate to EncryptedSharedPreferences/Keystore.

name: Weekly Bitmask Schedule Codec
description: isHourState: Boolean((1<<hour) & timeRanges.get(weekday)); 24-bit mask per weekday; wire keys mon..sun; UI day starts 5am.
behavior_summary: Encodes a full week of hourly restrictions in 7 integers.

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy codec verbatim for Family OS schedule engine.

name: TimeRestrictions Rule Contract
description: TimeSettingsRecord: timeRanges masks + quotas (minutes) + flags isDailyLimit/isMultiDevices/isLockNavigation/isLockComputer/isReportAlerts; PUT per device.
behavior_summary: Complete wire contract for device screen-time rules.

reusability_assessment.notes: Adopt as the device time-rule schema.

name: RRULE Calendar Restriction Engine
description: One-shot pause as iCalendar RRULE (FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1;UNTIL); restriction_type=3; anti-stacking delete-before-create.
behavior_summary: Standards-based recurrence instead of custom encoding.

reusability_assessment.notes: Use RFC 5545 for all Family OS calendar restrictions.

name: Routines Engine (Routine/Schedule/Policy)
description: Routine {type, icon, policy} -> Schedules {weekdays, start_time, duration_minutes, overrides} -> Policy {block_type 0/1/2, app_rules, web_rules}; full CRUD.
behavior_summary: Cleanest scheduling model: explicit schedules + per-routine policy.

reusability_assessment.notes: Base Family OS routines on this; resolve conflict priority vs bitmask system.

name: Per-App Rules Model
description: AppRule {id, exe, action 0/1/4, weekday quotas in minutes}; actions 2/3 unsupported; category-level blocking behind flag.
behavior_summary: Per-app allow/block/always-allow with daily quotas.

reusability_assessment.notes: Adopt action vocabulary 0/1/4 and minute quotas.

name: Web Filter Model + Category Taxonomy
description: WebRulesRecord: 5 flags + 30 numeric categories + domain exceptions {host:0..3}; school-locked category subset.
behavior_summary: Complete, shippable web-filter rule schema.

reusability_assessment.notes: Copy category IDs and domain-action mapping verbatim.

name: Remote Command Vocabulary (7 FCM actions)
description: MessageV1Interpreter dispatches update_location/update_policy/update_settings/disable_panic_mode/enable_logging/upload_logs/update_application from {message, signature} bundle.
behavior_summary: Minimal server-mediated command plane; no persistent socket.

reusability_assessment.notes: Adopt vocabulary; ADD HMAC signature verification (theirs is presence-only).

name: Parent Push Command Channel
description: POST v1/accounts/{id}/devices/{deviceUId}/notifications {name}; used for update_location (8s debounce) and disable_panic_mode only.
behavior_summary: Simplest possible command API: named notifications via server.

reusability_assessment.notes: Adopt named-notification command pattern + debounce.

name: Pairing Protocol
description: Download-link SMS -> device self-registration -> manual bind POST profiles/{pid}/devices {user_uid, mid}; unbind sets profile_id null. onboarding_token is dead code.
behavior_summary: No secrets on child device; explicit parent consent per bind.

reusability_assessment.notes: Adopt link+bind flow; ignore dead onboarding_token; consider adding QR as enhancement.

name: Notification Center + Alert Taxonomy
description: Pull-based center: items (15/page, 10s TTL), unread_count, mark_as_viewed; NotificationType 1..8 (ExtraTimeRequest, SocialAlert, AiChatbotAlert...).
behavior_summary: Server-persisted alerts with typed cards.

reusability_assessment.notes: Base Family OS alert cards on this taxonomy; feed to AI layer.

name: Places Geofence Model
description: Place {uid, name, latitude, longitude, radius default 100m, address}; CRUD v2/accounts/{uid}/places.
behavior_summary: Minimal geofence schema.

reusability_assessment.notes: Adopt schema; evaluate radius default for Family OS.
